description: Source code for the 'kubectl config set-context' command, which modifies or creates a context entry in kubeconfig.

classes.name: setContextOptions

methods.description: Executes the logic to set or modify a kubeconfig context based on provided options.

methods.name: modifyContext
methods.description: Modifies an existing context with new cluster, auth info, and namespace values if provided.

methods.description: Completes command-line argument parsing and validation.
